hints.title: Numeric IP Representation
hints.text: Convert the dotted decimal IP address into a 32-bit integer by shifting each octet.

hints.title: Lowest Set Bit Alignment
hints.text: The size of the largest power-of-two prefix block that can start at integer x is bounded by its lowest set bit, x & -x.

hints.title: Greedy Block Allocation
hints.text: At each step, take block size equal to the largest power of two that is at most n and does not exceed x & -x (or 2^32 if x is zero). Output the prefix string, advance x by block size, and decrement n.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of IP addresses to cover
complexity.notes: Greedy power-of-two decomposition using bitwise low-bit extraction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Emitting single-IP /32 blocks results in N entries instead of the minimal logarithmic covering.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise integer arithmetic requires O(log N) operations and space for formatted result strings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use lowest set bit (cur & -cur) to establish alignment and greedily reduce while exceeding remaining n.
